acceptance_criteria.description: The diff is confined to the nine owned paths, keeps Cargo.lock and all manifests unchanged, and preserves sizeof(MapHeader), sizeof(WorldLocation), the bridge ABI, and protocol version 1.
mapjson emits each map's explicit engine region, defaulting only an absent value to Hoenn, into the existing MapHeader byte at offset 0x19 without changing structure size.

ROM location export derives Hoenn, Kanto, or Sevii from the generated engine region plus section, classifies FRLG special-area maps as Kanto, rejects unknown or contradictory inputs, and preserves all existing numeric location fields.

A deterministic standard-library generator reads repository map sources and emits a checked-in Rust catalog covering every map exactly once with unique region-qualified canonical keys and unique numeric map coordinates.

coop-protocol exposes exact forward and reverse catalog resolution plus WorldZone validation/translation while retaining its version-1 string map field; cross-region and nonexistent pairs fail typed validation.
Tests cover all region boundaries, Sevii, Kanto special areas, contradictions, complete generated-catalog coverage, uniqueness, forward/reverse resolution, and generator drift.
The focused ROM tests, modern ROM build, generator check, protocol tests/clippy, formatting, and diff checks pass.

closed_decisions: Treat the map JSON region field as the engine-region authority: missing means Hoenn, explicit Kanto remains Kanto, and Sevii is derived from the existing GetKantoSubregion section authority.
Rename and reuse MapHeader's existing offset-0x19 filler byte; do not add a field or alter structure size.
Keep WorldLocation's fixed-width numeric layout and bridge ABI unchanged.
Keep WorldZone version 1 serialized as region plus canonical string map plus channel. Add catalog-backed resolution/validation instead of changing its wire shape.
Use map IDs without the MAP_ prefix as canonical WorldZone map keys and require exact uppercase ASCII spelling.
Generate and check in the Rust table using only Python's standard library; generator output must be deterministic and support --check without writing.
Do not attempt trainer, badge, fly-point, story-event, or SaveBlock persistence registries in this unit.

read_only_prefixes: rtk git diff -- include/global.fieldmap.h tools/mapjson/mapjson.cpp include/coop/region.h src/coop/region.c test/coop/region.c coop/crates/coop-protocol/src/lib.rs

focused: rtk wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 --cd C:/Users/User/Documents/personal/.codex-worktrees/hoenn-sessions/phase2-regional-map-catalog -- make check "TESTS=Cloud Coop"

forbidden_changes: Do not edit files outside the owned list, add dependencies, alter Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock, stage, commit, fetch, pull, push, deploy, or publish.
Do not change protocol numbers, bridge message layouts, WorldLocation layout, WorldZone JSON fields, or MapHeader size.
Do not infer Sevii from trainer ranges or create incomplete trainer/badge/fly/story catalogs.
Do not hand-maintain the generated Rust table or silently accept catalog drift, duplicate coordinates, duplicate qualified keys, or unrecognized map regions.
objective: Make ROM map identity region-authoritative and expose one generated, drift-checked host catalog without changing the version-1 bridge ABI or WorldZone JSON contract.

return_when: Every acceptance criterion is resolved and every required verification command has a recorded outcome.
A required behavior needs a bridge ABI, protocol-version, MapHeader-size, WorldZone-wire, dependency, lockfile, or unowned-file change.
A concrete generator, map-source, compiler, or tooling blocker prevents further progress within the owned files and budget.
